labels.MEASURED: value read from vidIQ/YouTube metadata or from a transcript on 2026-11-04
labels.VIDIQ_MODEL: vidIQ-computed (outlierScore, vph): a model output, not a YouTube number
labels.ESTIMATE: our arithmetic or reading; stated as such
labels.NOT_MEASURED: not observable from outside the channel (CTR, retention, impressions) or not run for cost

method_limits: Transcript timestamps come in ~15 s caption blocks: the first-5-s technique is read from the first words, other times are +/-15 s.
Cut rate and visual pacing are NOT measurable from a transcript; the only measured cut rates are the 2026-10-26 audits (evidence/vidiq/20261026/bible_story_shorts.json).
CTR, retention and impressions of other channels are not observable; transcript structure is a proxy, not a cause.
Mine structure only. No topic wording or visual is copied; non-canonical content (2 Enoch, Nephilim attacks) is recorded as a pattern, never as material.

maps.first_line: Thousands were dead, completely beyond hope. Then God asked one man, 'Can these bones live?'
maps.hook_0_5: stakes statement (thousands dead, no hope) + a quoted question from God inside the first 5 s
maps.hook_0_30: scene set in 2 sentences; the question is asked a second time at 0:33 (open loop #1, paid 1:09)
maps.promise: the question itself ('can these bones live?'); the title says 'most powerful vision'
rehooks: 1:41 'But they were completely lifeless' (second loop: breath)
peaks: 1:25 'one bone found another, then another' (rising repetition)
maps.cta: 2:44 'Comment: My dry bones will live' + follow
maps.pacing: about 4 s per sentence (estimate), one escalating verb chain at 1:25

maps.first_line: Why did God remove the Garden of Eden from Earth?
maps.hook_0_5: the title question spoken verbatim as line 1; line 2 (0:05) promise: 'the answer is astonishing'
maps.hook_0_30: recap in 2 sentences (gates slammed, cherubim), then a time jump 'Thousands of years later... Enoch' at 0:16 (a second beginning)
rehooks: 0:50 'Then Paul said...' / 'Then Jesus turned to the dying thief' (two chained 'Then' beats)
maps.payoff: 1:05 'Maybe Eden was never truly lost' (a soft reframe, not a reveal)
maps.pacing: about 20 words per 8 s, no filler (estimate)

maps.first_line: (Arabic) He built a giant ship on dry land. Everyone laughed at him. Then the rain began to pour.
maps.hook_0_5: the title is the first line: an act, a reaction (mockery) and a reversal ('Then it rained') in 3 short sentences

maps.payoff: moral at the end: 'Trust God when it does not make sense. After every storm there is'
maps.ending: transcript ends mid-sentence on 'After every storm there is' (INFERRED loop mechanic: the cut joins the first line; not confirmed by watching)
maps.pacing: 29 s, about 1 sentence per 3 s (estimate); likes 1,056 / 20,242 views = 5.2% (MEASURED)
